summary: F19 header fidelity plus its focus gate: the title and status line stay separated by the 16px slate-200 divider and the status dot keeps its 4px state ring with the amber measuring pulse and the indigo rebinding ping, and the dot now stops requesting frames while the window is unfocused while still painting its current frame.

HEADER-TITLE-DIVIDER-AND-STATUS-RING.evidence: The divider, the state ring, and both animations are carried by a8641026 and re-executed here (the_title_and_status_are_separated_by_the_reference_divider, the_synced_dot_wears_the_emerald_ring, the_idle_dot_stays_slate_without_an_animation, the_measuring_dot_pulses_amber, the_rebinding_dot_pings_indigo, the_pulse_and_ping_waves_match_the_reference_cycles, the_dot_state_follows_the_reference_precedence). This execution adds the focus gate: status_dot reads state.focused, the same flag the app loop feeds the preview clock and the timeline, and skips its repaint request while the window is deactivated; the_unfocused_dot_paints_the_frame_but_requests_no_repaint pins that both the measuring and the rebinding dot still paint their frame but schedule no frames, and the unowned ui_semantic rebinding flow still passes.

risks: The ring steps amber-100 (#fef3c6) and emerald-100 (#d0fae5) and the indigo-500 ink (#615fff) are derived from the reference's Tailwind v4 oklch declarations; the conversion reproduces five verified theme read-backs exactly, but theme.rs owns no such tokens and is outside this task's ownership (preview.rs carries the same indigo-500 for its dot highlight).

The dot requests its next frame at the backend's predicted frame time plus a millisecond rather than a fixed 60 Hz delay, because egui subtracts the predicted frame time from every request and a smaller delay collapses into an immediate repaint loop; the animation therefore follows the backend cadence.

The focus flag is read from state.focused rather than from egui input inside the header; the app loop is the single owner that derives it from InputState::focused, matching the preview clock and timeline call sites.

The inactive state folds the disconnected runtime into the reference's engine-off slate pair, because the reference has no separate connection state and no engine status can be trusted without a connection.
Native visual confirmation is outside this execution; the divider, ring, animations, and focus gate are pinned by egui_kittest widget and unit tests only.
